description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageAPI class which handles CRUD operations for employee language data in the OrangeHRM system, including endpoints for getting, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee language records via REST API.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee language data, extending Endpoint and implementing CRUD operations with validation, and supporting Swagger documentation.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeLanguageService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee language record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number, language ID, and fluency ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of employee language records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new language record to an employee.

methods.name: setEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Assigns competency and comment fields to an EmployeeLanguage entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more employee language records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getLanguageIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for language ID parameter.

methods.name: getFluencyIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for fluency ID parameter.

methods.name: getCompetencyIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for competency ID parameter.

methods.name: getCommentRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for comment parameter.
